description: Alert rules as live conditional styling in Svelte 5. A rule with a highlight or badge action becomes conditional formatting painted through the grid's own format pipeline: a server fleet lights up by rule, hot CPU turns amber and near-full disks turn red through a cross-column rule of used divided by total over 0.9, alongside in-cell data bars, CPU sparklines and status pills. Randomise the load and the colours follow, and the visual builder adds your own styling rule.

faq.question: How do highlight rules combine with other formats?
faq.answer: SvGridAlerts binds a formats array that the demo merges with its own data-bar formats before passing to conditionalFormats, so rules and static formats coexist.

faq.question: Can a rule compare two columns?
faq.answer: Yes. The expression language reads any column, so diskUsed / diskTotal > 0.9 is a valid condition and it re-evaluates whenever either value changes.

faq.question: Does styling need the alerts panel?
faq.answer: No. Rules with only a highlight or badge action paint the grid silently; add a toast or log action when you also want a notification.
